checks.finding: Requirements REQ-001 through REQ-006 define concrete, observable, and measurable criteria using RFC 2119 keywords with unambiguous verification obligations across all six requirements.

Complete bidirectional traceability exists from all five stated goals to requirements REQ-001 through REQ-006 and acceptance criteria AC-001 through AC-014, including test coverage mappings TEST-001a through TEST-001i.
All acceptance criteria AC-001 through AC-014 specify externally observable behaviors, states, and artifact boundaries with designated test types and dedicated fixtures.

Scope boundaries, non-goals, and deferred work are explicitly delimited; references to downstream artifacts (design.md, traceability.md) have been removed, resolving prior phase-sequencing concerns under Pending status.

Material constraints covering backward compatibility, fail-closed gate evaluation, security/consent policies, versioned migration requirements, and implementation-stage gating are explicitly specified.
All documented risks (resolver assumption, gate weakening, UI consent regression, provider leakage) have explicit planned validation surfaces and corresponding acceptance test suites.

The target repository has no domain/ directory or approved domain contract; domain conformance is satisfied with no conflicting bounded-context semantics or forbidden synonyms, fully aligning with ADR-0016, ADR-0017, and ADR-0018.
